name: WinPad
brief: A short run with a win counter: a start floor with a SpawnLocation, 3 platforms, and a win pad. Touching the win pad gives the player 1 Win and sends them back to the start.
contract: Create a SpawnLocation named Start inside script.Parent on the start floor.
Name the platforms Stage1 ... Stage3 in jump order; the win pad is a Part named Goal.
leaderstats IntValue named Wins starting at 0. Touching Goal adds 1 Win once per visit and moves the character back onto Start.
